overview: This Senate resolution congratulates the Johnson County Community College Cavaliers of Kansas for winning the 2026 national baseball championship of the National Junior College Athletic Association's Division I, the top division for two-year colleges. It notes the team's 67-3 record, its 8-5 win over Blinn College in the title game, and a comeback from six runs down in the semifinal. It recognizes the players, coaches, staff and supporters, and wishes the team continued success. The resolution is ceremonial and does not change any law. As of June 24, 2026, the Senate had approved it.
for: Supporters say it rightly honors the student-athletes and coaches for a historic season that brought pride to their community and state.
against: Critics say it is symbolic and does not change any law or spending.
